# pve_node_services (Data Source)

Services of a node: list, and per-service detail/state when a service is specified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_node_services" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `service` (String) Service ID

### Read-Only

- `detail` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/services/{service}. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<service>.
- `services` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
- `state` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state))

<a id="nestedatt--detail"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail`

Read-Only:

- `subdir` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `active_state` (String) Current state of the service process (systemd ActiveState).
- `desc` (String) Description of the service.
- `name` (String) Short identifier for the service (e.g., "pveproxy").
- `service` (String) Systemd unit name (e.g., pveproxy).
- `state` (String) Execution status of the service (systemd SubState).
- `unit_state` (String) Whether the service is enabled (systemd UnitFileState).
